title: Width of a beam whose drawn width differs from the schedule
source: S9A 05 B_SOURCE (schedule vs drawn)
rationale: The schedule is the design table; the drawn width is the alternative. The range covers both widths under both depth readings.

title: What the beam schedule depth H is measured from
source: ST7757 pp.10-12 beam schedule (H printed, datum not printed); S9 02 conditional point; S9A 05
rationale: TOTAL_DEPTH (B x H x L, slab strip inside H) is S9's own conditional point and the usual schedule convention; BELOW_SLAB (B x (H + t) x L) is the alternative and sets the high end. Open as RFI-A01.

title: Thickness of the hatched cantilever portions
source: ST7757 p.8 note 18: normal slabs 16 cm unless stated otherwise; S9A 03
rationale: No local thickness is printed for the bands, so the project default applies; the band classification itself is S9A's measurement, not engineer-confirmed (RFI-A08).

title: Section of a column whose drawn section differs from the schedule
source: S9A 09 (drawn vs schedule, interpretation vs conflict)
rationale: The schedule section is the base; the drawn outline is the alternative (RFI-A04).

title: Length of the curved B7 bands
source: S9A 05 (arc centre length only)
rationale: Only the centre arc length is held; it is an upper bound on the clear length (a small overstatement).

title: Dome ring main bars
source: S8.3 12 SA-*-RINGBARS (closed circles; symmetric bars, cover cancels)
rationale: Printed ring bars as closed circles at the ring centreline; laps and links excluded.

title: Depth of the dome ring beams
source: S8.3 12 sensitivity cases (B4 schedule row 0.50 m; architectural drum 1.30 m)
rationale: The ring band is tagged B4, whose schedule depth is 0.50 m; the 1.30 m architectural drum is the high end (it may be a wall, not the ring).

title: Ring position (plan band or detail band)
rationale: The drawn plan band is the base; the detail position the alternative.

title: Footing blinding thickness (exposure only)
source: P8-N16 (mix only); no footing blinding detail
rationale: Exposure only; never in a total.

title: Footing tagged both F and F10
source: S9 02 FTG-CONFLICT_F_F10 (drawn outline 3.25 x 1.40 m)
rationale: F10 (2.80 x 1.40) is the schedule row nearest the drawn outline; F (0.90 x 0.80) is the alternative.

title: Founding level below plot level (footing underside)
source: ST7757 general note: excavation >= 1.50 m below plot level; S9 / S8.8 indicative basis
rationale: The printed minimum is the base (and the low end: a deeper founding lengthens necks and pit walls). 2.00 m is a planning upper bound, not a printed value (RFI-A03).

title: Blinding under ground beams
source: ST7757 p.16 typical: G.B on '50 x 10' blinding (read as 500 mm wide x 100 mm thick)
rationale: The typical detail's thickness, under a 500 mm strip along every ground beam; typical detail, not a project-specific plan.

title: Blinding strip width under ground beams
source: ST7757 p.16 typical '50 x 10'
rationale: Read with GB_BLINDING.

title: Section of a ground beam carrying a concentrated load
source: S5 flag NO_PROJECT_DETAIL_FOR_CONCENTRATED_LOAD
rationale: No project detail exists; the typical class section is the minimum plausible, the > 5 m section (30 x 60) the high end.

title: Floor build-up above the exterior ground beams
source: S5 depth bound: D = (+1.00 - build-up) - NGL, NGL >= +0.00 (BOUNDED_ABOVE, 1.00 m); p.13 'FOLLOW ARCH.'
rationale: The exterior depth is bounded above by 1.00 m; a 0.10 m tiled-floor build-up gives the base depth 0.90 m. Range 0.80 - 1.00 m.

title: Spans S5 flags as exterior candidates
source: S5 why_candidate (architectural exterior wall above the span); S9A 08
rationale: An exterior wall above the span makes it an exterior ground beam; the interior class section is the alternative.

title: Lowest reading of an exterior ground-beam depth
source: S5 BOUNDED_ABOVE (upper bound only); ST7757 p.13 class sections
rationale: S5 gives the exterior depth an upper bound only. The low end of the range is the typical p.13 class section for the span length (an exterior beam no shallower than the typical one). It sets the low end only; the base stays 1.00 - build-up.

title: Span length that selects the ground-beam class
source: S9A 08 (class by c/c and by clear length)
rationale: Span conventionally means centre to centre of supports; the clear-length class is the alternative.

title: Reading of the p.13 ground-beam section titles
rationale: Read as exclusive length bands (< 2.5 / 2.5 - 5 / > 5 m), the only reading that gives one section per span (RFI-A05). The alternative: below 2.5 m both titles hold and the deeper 30 x 40 section is taken (high end).

title: Extent of the 'T=10cm, 5D10/m E.W.' slab-on-grade note
source: ST7757 GBP note; S8.1 / S8.1A; S9 02 conditional faces
rationale: The printed thickness and mesh are applied to every slab-on-grade face, not only the two source-zoned cells (RFI-A06).

title: Hook and closure allowance per closed link or tie loop
source: S3.1 tie model (2 x 75 mm per tie, HOOK_1 / HOOK_2 rows); D1.1: no bend radius, hook length or closure printed
rationale: The beam and ground-beam link models exclude hooks; the column tie model used 150 mm per tie. M1 applies one allowance to every closed loop: base 150 mm (as S3.1), low 0 (core path only), high 200 mm (two 10d hooks on a 10 mm bar).

title: Lintels S8.6A could not release
source: S9 02 / 03 lintel conditional rows (S8.6A)
rationale: S8.6A's own conditional concrete and its sensitivity bars; blocked lintels (no confirmed head) range down to 0.

title: Top of the foundation necks (GF structural level)
source: S9 02 neck indicative basis (+1.00); S8.8 pit-wall basis
rationale: The +1.00 level S9 and S8.8 already use for the indicative neck and pit-wall heights.

title: Pool base thickness
source: S8.2 / S8.2A: 40 cm dimensioned on the deep base; SA-04
rationale: The printed 40 cm is applied to the whole structural footprint (the deep / shallow extents are 'AS PER ARCH').

title: Pool wall height above the base
source: S8.2A SA-01 (drawn depth 1.15 flat), SA-02 (+0.15 to the deck); shallow end not printed
rationale: The drawn deep-end depth is the base; 0.90 m a shallow-end low; 1.30 m with the wall to the +0.30 deck.

title: Width of strap beam SB2 (two schedule rows)
source: PRE-S5.1 08 (SBT rows 1FBB 80 x 50 and 2ABA 100 x 50; plan drawn 987 mm)
rationale: Two printed rows for one strap (Q-S2). The base takes row B, the width nearer the drawn 987 mm; row A gives the low end. Depth 50 cm is the same in both rows.

title: Slab-on-grade mesh
source: ST7757 GBP note '5D10/m E.W.'
rationale: Printed mesh, both ways, on the slab-on-grade area; no laps.

title: Stair riser arrangement
source: S8.7B owner scenarios (GF -> 1F 28, 1F -> 2F 27); S8.7C scenario spread
rationale: The owner scenarios S8.7B evaluated; S8.7C's alternative arrangements move the GF -> 1F total by under 0.25 m3 at a given waist.

title: Stair flight waist / landing thickness
source: S8.7B 08 waist sensitivity grid (150 / 160 / 175 / 200); p.8 note 18 default 160
rationale: No waist is printed; the project slab default is the base, 150 - 200 the range (winders: the warped-soffit upper bound at the high end).

title: Column ties, laps, anchorages and starters S3.1 modelled
source: S9 03 COLUMNS conditional rows (S9-C01 ties; P8-N09 laps / anchorage; P13 starters)
rationale: S3.1's modelled parts with their printed lap / starter rules; tie hooks and bend radius are not printed (RFI-A02).

title: Beam and ground-beam links retracted by D1.1
source: S9 03 SUPERSEDED rows (S6.1 / S5.1 core-path links, D1.1 retraction)
rationale: The stages' own core-path link model (hooks excluded); D1.1 retracted it from the release because a core path is not a proven lower bound, not because the links are absent (RFI-A02).

title: What lies under the steps on grade
source: S8.7B 08 (B-F1, D-F1 conditional estimates)
rationale: A waist slab is the base; solid RC the high end; masonry or fill (no structural concrete) the low end.

title: Sunken slab drop depth (exposure only)
source: PRE-S7 SOURCE_EXPECTED_NOT_LOCATED
rationale: Exposure only; never in a total.

title: Depth range for untagged beam spans (exposure only)
source: beam schedule depths for drawn widths up to 250 mm (S9A 05)
rationale: Used only for the UNRESOLVED exposure range; never in a total.
